identitySignals: Envision Academy of Arts & Technology is a tuition-free public charter school (grades 6-12) in Oakland, CA at 1515 Webster St, matching an OUSD Measures N and H Commission MOU for a classroom and academic program

School website content names the school Envision Academy (also Envision Academy of Arts and Technology) and lists the 1515 Webster Street, Oakland address, with a copyright and careers link to Envision Education

ProPublica lists Envision Education Inc (EIN 94-3394659), a 501(c)(3) K-12 education nonprofit in Oakland, CA, which the school's own site and Envision Education's site tie to the school; the exact legal charter-holder was not confirmed on a registry page

The school's old domain (envisionacademy.org) now redirects to envisionscienceoakland.org, where the site appears rebranded as Oakland Science High School / Envision Science Oakland, so the current school name and website are uncertain
research.notes: The vendor named in the agenda is the school, but the legal operator is probably Envision Education Inc (EIN 94-3394659); a registry page tying the Oakland charter to that entity was not confirmed. The envisionacademy.org domain redirects to envisionscienceoakland.org, which appears to be a rebrand (Oakland Science High School / Envision Science Oakland), so the school name and website may have changed. Reviewer should confirm before publishing.

profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs public, tuition-free charter schools in the San Francisco Bay Area, including a middle and high school in Oakland. The school's website describes project-based, hands-on learning meant to prepare students for college.
